page_title: CRO 0-0 BEL | Croatia v Belgium 01/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' Timothy Castagne (Belgium) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90+2' Zlatko Dalic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lovro Majer (Croatia) replacing Mateo Kovacic.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Thorgan Hazard (Belgium) swings it in and Romelu Lukaku gets on the end of it, but Dominik Livakovic shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
88' The attendance for today's match is 43984.
87' A substitution has been made. Thomas Meunier goes off and Eden Hazard (Belgium) comes on.
87' Romelu Lukaku (Belgium) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
87' Timothy Castagne (Belgium) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
86' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
85' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Belgium get a corner.
85' Timothy Castagne (Belgium) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
84' Jeremy Doku (Belgium) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
82' Total attempts – 11:13.
81' Josip Juranovic (Croatia) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
79' A cross from Ivan Perisic (Croatia) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
79' Jan Vertonghen (Belgium) makes a weak connection with the corner kick, and his close-range header is easily blocked.
78' Thorgan Hazard (Belgium) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
78' Timothy Castagne (Belgium) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
78' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
77' Youri Tielemans (Belgium) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
76' Bruno Petkovic (Croatia) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
75' Poor challenge! Youri Tielemans (Belgium) is penalised for tripping and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle.
72' Roberto Martinez prepares a substitution. Leander Dendoncker is replaced by Youri Tielemans (Belgium).
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jeremy Doku (Belgium) for Yannick Carrasco.
71' Thomas Meunier (Belgium) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Dominik Livakovic, who smothers the ball.

69' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the top right corner. Unfortunately for him, Dominik Livakovic makes a great save to stop his effort.

68' Luka Modric (Croatia) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the right side of the goal, but Thibaut Courtois is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
67' Leander Dendoncker (Belgium) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
65' Half-chance! Borna Sosa (Croatia) plays a pass into the box, but Thibaut Courtois reacts well to snuff out the attack.
64' Here is a change. Andrej Kramaric is going off and Zlatko Dalic gives the last tactical orders to Mario Pasalic (Croatia).
64' Substitution. Bruno Petkovic (Croatia) has come on for Marko Livaja.
64' Luka Modric (Croatia) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
62' Great ball in from Kevin De Bruyne. Romelu Lukaku (Belgium) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar.

62' Romelu Lukaku (Belgium) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Anthony Taylor with no other option than to blow for a foul.
61' Romelu Lukaku (Belgium) spurns a big chance! He got to the rebound but only hit the right post!
61' Yannick Carrasco (Belgium) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
60' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) sends a cross into the box, but Thibaut Courtois comes off his line to gather the ball.
59' Substitution. Thorgan Hazard (Belgium) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Leandro Trossard walks off.
58' Borna Sosa (Croatia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Thibaut Courtois intercepts the ball.
55' Marko Livaja (Croatia) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement.
54' Luka Modric (Croatia) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
54' Marcelo Brozovic (Croatia) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Thibaut Courtois makes a save.
53' The cross into the penalty area from Borna Sosa (Croatia) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.

51' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball goes out of play and Croatia will have a goal kick.
51' Luka Modric (Croatia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
51' Croatia work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

50' Mateo Kovacic (Croatia) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper! The referee signals a corner kick to Croatia.
49' Dominik Livakovic makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Romelu Lukaku (Belgium) after a cross from the side.
49' Yannick Carrasco (Belgium) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
48' Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
48' A cross into the box from Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) is cleared. Belgium will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Roberto Martinez gives a chance to Romelu Lukaku (Belgium) and Dries Mertens is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' The ball sits up nicely on the edge of the box for Josip Juranovic (Croatia), but his powerful first-time shot flies well wide of the right post.
45+3' Leander Dendoncker (Belgium) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
45+3' Yannick Carrasco (Belgium) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
45+1' Dominik Livakovic is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Yannick Carrasco (Belgium). Easy save!
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Borna Sosa (Croatia) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
44' A pass from Kevin De Bruyne (Belgium) is intercepted by Dominik Livakovic and the move breaks down.
43' Chance! Dries Mertens (Belgium) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
41' Wonderful movement by Belgium. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
39' Axel Witsel (Belgium) trips an opposition player and Anthony Taylor signals a foul.
35' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Thomas Meunier (Belgium) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Croatia.
35' Yannick Carrasco (Belgium) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
33' Marko Livaja (Croatia) anticipates the cross from Borna Sosa, but powers his header way over the bar from the edge of the six-yard box.
33' That's unlucky! Marcelo Brozovic (Croatia) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
31' Dries Mertens (Belgium) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
29' Luka Modric (Croatia) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
27' The resulting corner from Luka Modric (Croatia) is cleared.

27' Borna Sosa (Croatia) and Ivan Perisic attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Croatia have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

26' Axel Witsel (Belgium) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
23' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:0.
21' The ball is cleared after Andrej Kramaric (Croatia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Croatia will have a throw-in.
20' Luka Modric (Croatia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
18' Dejan Lovren (Croatia) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
18' The Croatia players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Anthony Taylor. NO PENALTY!
17' Celebrations by Croatia are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
16' Luka Modric (Croatia) is going to take the penalty!
15' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul after Yannick Carrasco (Belgium) hacks down one of his opponents. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Croatia.
15' Luka Modric (Croatia) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
15' Axel Witsel (Belgium) brings an opponent down and Anthony Taylor interrupts the game. Croatia have been awarded a free kick.
13' That's a well-taken pass by Dries Mertens (Belgium). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
13' Josip Juranovic (Croatia) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Belgium.

11' Wow, what an escape. Yannick Carrasco (Belgium) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Belgium.
11' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Ivan Perisic (Croatia) offside.
10' Toby Alderweireld (Belgium) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
10' Yannick Carrasco (Belgium) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
7' Axel Witsel (Belgium) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.

6' Belgium slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
2' Marko Livaja (Croatia) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
2' Josip Juranovic (Croatia) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
1' That was close by Ivan Perisic (Croatia)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Croatia will take the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
